residency_notes: DeepInfra documents memory-only handling for standard inference but does not specify a customer-selectable data or execution region or a named account-level Zero Data Retention control. Bulk inference may use encrypted disk temporarily, image outputs may be retained briefly, and Google/Anthropic upstream policies can apply.
prompt_training_notes: DeepInfra says standard inference inputs and outputs are held in memory only and are not used for training. Exceptions include Google and Anthropic upstream models, bulk inference's short-lived encrypted disk storage, and short-term image-generation output storage. No account-level opt-out is documented; avoid those exceptions when a strict no-training/no-retention path is required.
